column1: # Cards that had a dirac/support/refused entry and no longer do, with the proof the defect is fixed.
# card <TAB> proof <TAB> why. The proof is a TestXxx that exists, or a dirac/oracle/testdata/repro/<name>.repro.json
# that replays clean (no divergence, no unmodelled stall) on a raw table of its own cards.
# TestUnrefusalNeedsProof fails for a card that had an entry at the merge base with land and has none now
# without a row here. An entry that went stale only because the pinned game moved is re-recorded

column3: the hidden public-origin pick now applies LibraryPosition$ (engine/effects/zone_hidden.go places what it moved), so the picked card lands on top of the library as dirac puts it
the resolving spell exiling itself (Origin$ Stack ChangeZone) leaves the stack at that op (dirac/interp_gen.go moveObj), so the untap pick after it sees it in exile and off the stack, as gorge does
a planned payment now activates its sacrificing sources last, as gorge orders its witness (dirac/mana.go), so the source tapped beside the Treasure matches when the Treasure's move waits on a choice

a cast whose shape gorge's potential planner refuses (an additional-cost forage or exile part, convoke, improvise, delve) takes no grant prefix in the kernel's grant and script searches (CR 601.2g-h), so the options the two engines offer match

the granted Attacks trigger's CR 603.3d placement offer now reads SVar:X from the grantor's table (Engine.triggerLineSVars in targetSpecContext), so with mana value 6 Old One Eye in the graveyard and X = the countered token's power 6 the trigger is placed with its target ask as dirac places it

a multi-target Destroy (up to three target creatures) is one simultaneous departure (dirac/zone_leavetogether.go), so the leaves and dies triggers of the victims see the same board as gorge and the two engines pose the same decisions

its pinned entry-order game (the land entering with an as-enters colour choice under the untap carrier) now replays clean past the CR 616.1 ask: the entering land's own as-enters choice record joins the ask (dirac/repl_entryorder.go entBodyRecord) and the answered choice survives the parked ask (dirac/turn_gen.go applyGen)

gorge's grant search (scriptSearch.visit) drops a payer state its seen key already holds before pricing it, so Gran-Gran's loot discarding the cast Rockalanche first shadows the discard of a Lesson that would let the hand cast be paid; the kernel's grant search priced that repeat and over-offered, and now drops it as gorge does (CR 601.2f, 106.4)

its pinned equip game (Hydraulic Helper, a restricted one-colour source that Captain America's Taps watcher untaps) now replays clean: scriptTapsDefer admits the restricted gap and floats it through floatRestrAb, and restrSrcAffords counts the deferred restricted source at sorcery speed (dirac/mana_tapsdefer.go, dirac/mana_restrictedsource.go)

an announced Sac<X> activation with no {X} and no XMin is planned by gorge like any other cost (PlanCostDetail returns cost:x only for X or XMin, planCostParts skips the announced Sac part), so the kernel offers it when the pool pays the mana half (CR 602.2, 118.3); the XMin$ param fold on a Sac<X> ability is not mirrored by gorge (costAnnouncesX) and only Radiant Lotus, a mana ability, carries it

its recorded game (two Cephalids naming one Angelic Protector, then combat) now replays clean: gorge evaluates the Effect's ValidSource$ Card.IsRemembered against the Effect's capture, so the "dealt by" half prevents as the kernel's KwPreventCombatDamageFrom grant does (CR 615.1), and neither side poses a CR 616.1 order ask between bare full preventions, whose order is unobservable (engine/rules/replacement_damage.go allBarePreventions, dirac/repl_bareprev.go barePrevOnly)

its pinned repetitions game (the open Announce$ NumTimes announce whose eighth repetition was payable) now replays clean: the open announce latent reads the announced count the reflexive trigger rides in (the parent X as OpReflexiveTrigger B, gorge resolution.go), so the kernel holds gorge own 64 bound instead of stalling past seven (dirac/cast_announcetimes.go numTimesCost, dirac/kgen/lower_numtimes.go)

its pinned repetitions game replays clean on a table of its own cards: the open Announce$ NumTimes announce holds gorge own 64 bound (0a69565e34, as for Primal Adversary), and the matchup subtype table keeps the four party roles a Count$Party value reads by name (dirac/kgen/emit.go keepPartyRoles, CR 700.8)

dirac's filter search now bounds a path by the same potentialScriptNodes budget as gorge's script search instead of sixteen steps, so on the pinned Candleguide-only green it spends the budget as gorge does and offers no activation: the recorded game replays clean (gorge leaves the animate census_incomplete, CR 602.2b/605.3a)

its recorded game (tail-16 pair 32, the may-pay {1} trigger cost over a storage battery, Subterranean Hangar) now replays clean: a trigger own cost counts a storage battery as a mana source and the oracle answers a window storage X at the maximum, so both sides offer choose:trigger_cost_pay (CR 118.3, 605.3b; dirac/interp_ask.go, dirac/oracle/gorge.go, 1e9beeedc4)

its {2},{T} dynamic-amount mana ability is now offered by dirac: the relaxed proof takes a paid filter that makes fewer mana than its fee a subset at a time (dirac/mana_filtersubset.go, CR 605.3a), so the pinned game replays clean past decision 146, where it diverged before a2ea8c36c1

the counter-scaled {T}, sacrifice mana ability is a counter-cost script gap (dirac/mana_sacctr.go, dirac/mana_countercost.go), so the kernel prices the cast gorge's potential walk funds with it; the pinned Bushmeat Poacher cast at decision 140 now replays clean (CR 601.2g, 605.1a)

its recorded game (mz pool pair 3, damage to a shield-countered attacker beside Maze of Ith's Effect prevention) now replays clean through decision 321 with its whole script served: the kernel asks the CR 616.1 order for a depleting shield beside a granted prevention (dirac/combat_prevention.go, 7d5dfe3830)

its recorded game (tail-74-c000 pair 5) now replays clean: the kernel prices an any-colour counter-scaled sacrifice source for the colour the cast needs, so at decision 86 both sides offer Lotus Blossom and Novellamental from one petal and a Mountain (CR 605.1a, 106.4; dirac/mana_sacctr.go, be4db3171d)

its pinned attack game (the game ends while a Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters-battlefield charm trigger is still on the stack, the kernel one stack item up at projection NStack) now replays clean past decision 548 to 634: gorge no longer moves a phased-out permanent with an Attach (CR 702.26b, engine/effects/attach.go attachObjectGone, 699903f7bf), so the stack the game ends on matches; its return-tapped game (std-msh pair 317, Thor exiles and returns A.I.M. Synthoids tapped) also replays clean: Captain America, Living Legend's untap of the creature it became tapped no longer reaches the new object the exile and return made (CR 400.7, engine/effects/untap.go effUntap); the earlier stack_differs recording stays a regression

its recorded game (tail-66 pair 1, Island, Island and Witherbloom Campus with only mana value 1 and 3 creatures) now replays clean: the X-bound target sweep is bounded by the payment planner on both sides, so neither offers the X=1 cast it cannot pay (CR 601.2b, 601.2c; #1249)

its Reliquary Dragon token (a token script's Colors:all) reads every colour in the kernel's lowering now (dirac/kgen/lower.go colorsOf, CR 105.1), so the recorded game's projection Cards[82].Chars.Colors (ref=31 kernel=0) matches and it replays clean on a raw table of its own cards

its recorded game (cast trigger countered by ward) now replays clean: a ward trigger whose warded stack object is an ability counters that ability, not the spell of the same source still on the stack beneath it (dirac/resolve.go wardedIndex, CR 702.21a)

its copy of a face-down permanent now takes the face-down copiable values, a 2/2 colourless Creature (dirac/copy_facedown.go, CR 707.2, 707.3), so the recorded game projection Cards[30].Flags/Power/Types (ref 2/2 Creature, kernel 0/0) matches and it replays clean on a raw table of its own cards

CR 400.4a: the pinned game's divergence was the until-host-leaves return of a manifested instant/sorcery (p0's Sheltered by Ghosts over p1's Manifest Dread): both sweeps put the sorcery back on the battlefield, gorge as a creature target, the kernel not; both sweeps now leave the card in exile, so the recorded game replays clean

the kernel's grant search now carries gorge's phased fallback (free gaps, then covered funding, then the fee-carrying gaps), so the {4}{B} flashback through Elven Chorus's grant floats the two granted taps, the four Eldrazi Spawn sacrifices, a Forest and Prismite's two {2} filters and the recorded tail-51 pair 34 game replays clean (dirac/mana_grantedoffers.go scriptPhase order)

its pinned game (Eclipsed Realms beside its {R/W}{R/W} activation) now replays clean: a lowered hybrid activation resolves its witness over the restricted sources and floating restricted mana the activation may spend (dirac/mana_resolutionpay.go hybResolveAct, CR 106.6), as gorge planHybridCost does

Jungle Patrol's Sac<1/token named Wood>: Add {R} production now counts once per extra sacrifice candidate in gorge's potential bound (engine/rules/potential_repeat_fee.go addPotentialSacRepeat, CR 605.1a) and per candidate without the whole-pool open in the kernel's plain potential fold (dirac/legal.go sacAnyRepeatUnits, CR 107.4a), so the recorded buyback game replays clean

Baxter Building's {4},{T} any-colour fee now funds the second {U} of the {1}{U}{U} cast in the kernel's filter prefix search as it does in gorge (dirac/mana_filterfeeorder.go fee-order fallback, CR 601.2g, 605.3a-b), so the recorded game replays clean and both engines offer the cast

the first-only filter's admission bound now counts an all-at-once source's whole production (dirac/mana_filterfirst.go filtOtherMana, CR 605.3b, 605.1a), so Azorius Chancery's {W}{U} funds Cabal Coffers' {2} and its {B} per Swamp pays the {B}, sacrifice-a-Swamp activation as gorge prices it; the pinned tail-41-c000 pair 12 game replays clean

its recorded game (The World Tree's granted any-colour answer under gorge's 160-clone prefix search) now replays clean: the kernel's mirrored grant search re-reads each candidate's grants after a sacrifice step (dirac/mana_grantcost.go sacBranch/tapSacBranch, refreshGrants), so its node count below a sacrificed granter matches gorge's and Kor Haven's {1}{W} is no longer offered where gorge prices it census_incomplete

the kernel's phased fallback now walks a Taps-deferred gap beside a repeatable fee-only filter as gorge's plainLimited phased run does (dirac/mana_filter.go phasedFallback, CR 605.3a, 602.2b), so Signpost Scarecrow's two {2}: any-colour activations fund the {G/U}{G/U} pips and the recorded tail-45 pair 41 game replays clean

the kernel's filter search walks gorge's printed colour order (playNeed no longer reads a graveyard cast's pips; mana_grantedoffers.go playNeedHint), so it spends its node budget on the {5}{B}{G} flashback beside the two {1},{T} filter lands as gorge's prefix search does and withholds the cast as gorge does; the recorded game replays clean

the kernel filter search no longer prunes the free branch beside a dynamic-amount filter (dirac/mana_filter.go freeBranchHopeless fails open on anyDynFilt, CR 605.3b), so it withholds the activation gorge's budget-exhausted prefix search withholds and the recorded game replays clean

the kernel filter search no longer prunes the free branch beside its dynamic-amount filter (dirac/mana_filter.go freeBranchHopeless fails open on anyDynFilt, CR 605.3b), so it withholds the cast gorge's budget-exhausted prefix search withholds and the recorded game replays clean
